title: Mujrayi koi na karta tha dawaae sajjad
body:
Mujrayi koi na karta tha dawaae sajjad
shimr ka hukm tha pani bhi na paae sajjad
<<DIVIDER>>
qoone dil peete the aur baap ka gham khaate the
thi maraz me wo dawa aur ye ghizaae sajjad
<<DIVIDER>>
teen shaqso ka hai aafaaq me rona mash'hoor
giryae aadamo yaqoobo bukaae sajjad
<<DIVIDER>>
darde dil daaghe rasan maatame shaahe shohada
leke soughaat madine me ye aaye sajjad
<<DIVIDER>>
ae falak ba rehna paa dhoop me kaanto pe rawaa'n
koi beemar bhi dekha hai siwaae sajjad
<<DIVIDER>>
kyu na mohtaaj kafan ke ho hussain ibne ali
na to zainab ki rida thi na abaae sajjad
<<DIVIDER>>
har qadam par yahi zanjeer se aati thi sada
ayyuhan naas nahi kuch bhi qataae sajjad
<<DIVIDER>>
kehte the raah me karde koi ek saaghare aab
fateha waalide bekas ka dilaae sajjad
<<DIVIDER>>
jab ke manzil pe utarte the sare shaam adu
bibiya chunti thi qaare kafe paaye sajjad
<<DIVIDER>>
nange sar oonto pe zahra ka jo kunba tha sawaar
jaate the sharm se gardan ko jhukaae sajjad
<<DIVIDER>>
yu riwaayat hai ke zindaane sitam se chut kar
baap ki laash pe chehlum ko jab aaye sajjad
<<DIVIDER>>
roke farmaaya ye qismat me mere likkha tha
sathra qabre azeezo ki banaaye sajjad
